physical_carplay_negotiation.observed_transport: IPv6 only on carplay0; stock video established over tcp6
physical_carplay_negotiation.physical_validation_result: CARPLAY_ACTIVE display=1 context=70 size=800x480; user confirmed Apple Maps content on right instrument display
physical_carplay_negotiation.application_behavior: Apple Maps supplied visible alternate-display map pixels during active route guidance. Switching to Google Maps kept the CarPlay cluster context active but produced a black instrument display; the original Porsche map was therefore hidden even though no useful Google map pixels were visible.
physical_carplay_negotiation.black_frame_policy: Decoded I420 luma is validated before publication. Blank, nominal-black, low-contrast and malformed frames cannot activate context 70. If an already visible stream becomes blank, the supervisor immediately restores the recorded OEM map context while leaving the decoder available for later useful frames.
physical_carplay_negotiation.airplay_avcc_suffix: 02000000 accepted only as the physically observed four-byte AirPlay display extension
physical_carplay_negotiation.source_of_evidence: Physical v14 test logs, tcp6 connection, decrypted AVCC frames, decoder/renderer readiness, CARPLAY_ACTIVE and user screen observation
